description: This file defines the HorizontalXAxisRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering and formatting the horizontal X axis in chart visualizations within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for initializing axis info, calculating space requirements, drawing axis lines, tick marks, labels, and titles, and computing axis scale values.

classes.name: HorizontalXAxisRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders the horizontal X axis for charts, handling layout, tick marks, labels, and axis titles.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer info based on the chart's X axis, setting up axis properties and labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space needed for axis titles and tick labels to prepare for drawing.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the axis line, tick marks, labels, and title on the graphics context.

methods.name: CalculateXAxisValues
methods.description: Determines the scale, tick intervals, and tick mark widths for the X axis based on chart data.

methods.name: InitXValues
methods.description: Initializes the X values for the axis, either from user data or default numeric sequence.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Calculates the start and end positions for major and minor tick marks based on axis settings.
